faq.q: What is the origin of Gunawan?
faq.a: Gunawan is associated with Indonesian. Gunawan is Indonesian, from guna ('use, virtue') + the suffix -wan, meaning 'useful, virtuous'.
No — the underlying form is Indonesian, not Arabic.
Gunawan can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Indonesian-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
